cockpit_summon: Lum micro menu -> CROWN -> explicit user gesture
desktop_summon: Lum micro menu -> DESK or small window launcher
notes: 1.0.8 reconciliation keeps the native Godot 4 world as the primary app layer, adds the original lightweight desktop/window interaction model and bottom visual-novel dialogue dock, and integrates the local-only physical proof receipt for presentation mode, realm, session, savepoint counter and restored session. The persistent HUD remains minimal. The full WebView cockpit still requires an explicit CROWN action. Proof mode/realm changes never grant authority. Android enforces package, signer, versionCode and installer confirmation.
